title: Serve until separation starts healing
summary: This meets the ache of long separation and devotional dryness. The line says day-and-night service and remembrance begin healing what lifetimes of distance have done.
takeaway: Serve steadily and let longing ripen.
lifeApplication: When longing turns theatrical or despairing, keep the next small act of service and prayer moving. Let steadiness do what drama cannot.

source.shortMeaning: Steady service and remembrance begin healing long separation.
source.lifeApplication: When distance hurts, keep serving through the day and night instead of dramatizing it.

evidence.turn: Stay in service and remembrance until separation begins healing.
